verdict.rationale: Apple's own pages confirm the M4 family has a Neural Engine running on-device models, and that official ML frameworks ship today: Core ML, MLX, PyTorch Metal backends, and MPS Graph integration of Core ML models. The pack never gives a TOPS figure or precision for the Neural Engine, and no cited material shows these SDKs explicitly targeting the Neural Engine rather than the GPU. Missing for 10: a published Neural Engine TOPS figure with stated precision, explicit documentation that Core ML or another SDK targets the Neural Engine on M4 Pro, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
